en: The Discourse on the Full Understanding of Delusion.
This was said by the Blessed One, said by the Arahant; so I have heard:
"Bhikkhus, one who does not directly know delusion, does not fully understand it, and does not cause the mind to fade away from it and abandon it, is incapable of the destruction of suffering."
“Monks, by directly knowing and fully understanding delusion, and by causing the mind to fade away from it and abandoning it, one is capable of the destruction of suffering.
Thus the Blessed One spoke. With reference to this, it is said:
“Having fully understood that delusion by which beings, being deluded, go to a bad destination— ”
Those who possess insight abandon them;
having abandoned them, they never again return to this world.
This matter too was spoken by the Blessed One; thus have I heard.
